hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard|git\s+clean\s+-f)'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Commande dangereuse détectée. Confirmez avant de continuer."}'; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; npx eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --quiet "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
